title: Bioluminescent Drift — A Reef in Deep Space
description: Jellyfish the size of cathedrals drift past a coral reef that has no business existing in a nebula. Made in an afternoon, entirely on vibes.

title: The Midnight Express Runs on Gold
description: A brass locomotive crosses a trestle bridge at sunset, trailing more steam than physics strictly allows. Hand-drawn look, generated frames.

title: Paper Observatory: Charting a Folded Sky
description: An entire observatory built from cut paper, parked on a cloud, pointed at stars that are also cut paper. Every layer generated, none of it glued.

title: Terraced Rain — Morning Over the Valley
description: Water steps down a hillside of rice terraces while the mist decides whether to lift. The calmest ten seconds in this showroom.

title: Hexshield — The Duel in the Great Hall
description: Two robed spellcasters, one hexagonal barrier, and a great deal of fire in a room with very expensive stained glass. Nobody insured it.

title: The Skyship Leaves at Dawn
description: A wooden sailing ship pushes off a waterfall's edge and out over a sea of cloud, past islands that forgot to fall. Departure is at first light.

title: The Last Train Out
description: Steam, a gloved hand, and about four seconds to say the thing. Shot in black and white because colour would have ruined it.
